name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Democratic Senate Candidates in Maine Denounce Deadly ICE Shooting
changes.summary: The killing of a man in Biddeford quickly became an issue in the Senate race, with Democrats aiming to tie Senator Susan Collins to President Trump’s immigration crackdown.

changes.title: Mercurial and Magnetic, Lindsey Graham Was a Force in the Senate
changes.summary: The sharp-witted South Carolinian repaired relations with President Trump to advance his foreign policy goals, was willing to cut deals with Democrats and tried to insert himself into every legislative fight.

changes.title: Trump urges S.C. governor to appoint Sen. Graham's sister as temporary replacement
changes.summary: Sen. Lindsey Graham died over the weekend at age 71, and Gov. Henry McMaster is expected to announce his pick later Monday.

changes.title: Trump suggests he has left a standing order to attack Iran if it assassinates him. But Vance would make the call
changes.summary: President Trump is suggesting he has left standing orders for the U.S. military to destroy Iran " at levels they've never seen before " if Tehran follows through on its long-standing threats to kill him.

changes.title: McMaster, Trump look to Graham's sister for Senate
changes.summary: President Donald Trump said Monday he wants South Carolina Gov. Henry McMaster to appoint Lindsey Graham’s sister, Darline Graham Nordone, to serve the remainder of the late senator’s term. One Republican familiar with McMaster’s plans said the governor intends to appoint Nordone to serve in the Senate for the rest of.

changes.title: How Lindsey Graham’s Journey From Trump Critic to Ally Made Him a Power Player
changes.summary: He initially called Donald Trump a “kook” who was “unfit for office,” only to join the new president’s Mar-a-Lago circle. “I’m still in the game,” Mr. Graham once explained of his much-analyzed turnabout.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: NPR has learned that the Department of Health and Human Services will not be finalizing its most aggressive attempt to end gender-affirming care for youth nationally. (Image credit: Erik McGregor).

changes.title: Ukraine fears it will have a weaker link to Trump after Sen. Lindsey Graham's sudden death
changes.summary: Ukraine has lost a close ally in President Donald Trump's orbit, leaving its leaders grappling with the implications for their war-torn country.

changes.title: ICE Agent Kills Person in Vehicle in Biddeford, Maine, State Officials Say
changes.summary: The killing occurred in Biddeford, about 20 miles south of Portland. The Trump administration has stepped up immigration enforcement nationally in recent weeks.

changes.title: Trump’s Threat to Impose Fees in the Strait of Hormuz Contradicts His Aides
changes.summary: President Trump said the United States could collect tolls or fees, despite Vice President JD Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio saying no country could do so.
